title: ChatDmBlockStateResult
description: chat.dm-block-state-result@1: the answer of GET /internal/chat/dm/block-state?a&b on OpenVibe.Chat (capability chat.messages.read): blocked is true when either user has blocked the other, in Chat's dm_blocks or as a Network platform block (dm.js isBlockedEither, the check the DM and call routes use). a and b are positive Live user ids and must differ; OpenVibe.Live asks this before sending a call invite. A failure is chat.ingress-ack@1's error.
